description: Start here to design a slide deck's slides yourself, as HTML. A call without layoutIds answers the guide to writing a slide for this report, which you follow, and what a slide is drawn on: the canvas size, the theme colours and, when the report has a template, its layouts by name. Call it again with layoutIds for the layouts you will use, to get the box each one's title goes in and the areas to keep clear.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

layoutIds.description: The layouts to describe in full, by their `id` from a first call without it. At most 10: repeat the parameter for each one, as in `?layoutIds=a&layoutIds=b`. Left out, only the template's style is described.

name: getReportDesign
title: Get report design
